sources.title: PDF LHD: Improving Cache Hit Rate by Maximizing Hit Density
sources.snippet: The cache's overall hit density is directly proportional to its hit rate, so maximizing hit density also maximizes the hit rate. Furthermore, it follows from basic arithmetic that replacing an object with one of higher density will increase the cache's overall hit density.1
